name: Alliance for National Restoration
description: The Alliance was established by disgruntled nationalists and ex-military personel in an aftermath of the lost Wars of Hegemony, decolonisation of Erdia, Passala and Elenia and most importantly - the secession of The Isle of the Six Kings. Their main goal is to reclaim lost lands and restore Graonia to its rightful place as a regional power via military and inner economic might. What's interesting is their lack of religious policy program. The most loyal supporters of the party are the military and 'ethnic' Graonians.
